notes.title: V1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Some fixes[/b][/h1]
[b]First off all, thanks to everyone supporting this game![/b]
Second, here is the list of all fixes and content added:
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] -Fixed price reduction upgrades increase the price instead of reduce it
[*] -Capped some augments, this fixes inventory flickers / errors late game.
[/list]
[h3]Content and QoL:[/h3]
[list]
[*] -Added auto collect xp upgrade
[*] -Added auto consume xp upgrade
[*] -Added 2x mining speed xp upgrade
[*] -Added toggles for xp upgrades
[*] -Added notification for if chamber is ready
[*] -Added visual queue for main currency going up or down, might need some tuning
[*] -Added some more QoL Hovers like time left for nuts to grow etc..
[/list]

These are the patch notes from 1.0.0 till 1.0.3.
The main game is now the same version as the test branch.
Enjoy!

If any bugs or ideas arise out of this update, do not hesitate to join discord! You can find the invite link on the main page of the game!

Greetings,
The_Robby

notes.title: RELEASE IS HERE!
notes.content:
[b][h1]IT IS TIME![/h1][/b]

[h2][b]Release is here :)[/b][/h2]
[h3]First off, I want to thank all the people who helped me getting the game stable.
For the people who first stumble upon my game now, feel free to try it out.
It is a small and short gaming experience but it keeps you hooked.
I am going to stop talking now, enjoy the release for those who waited![/h3]

In this update I have added a new kind of shop. This shop will allow players to buy permanent upgrades throughout the whole game. It works whit XP which you can get via rebirthing in game.

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new currency 'XP'
[*] Added new shop 'Permanent Shop'
[*] Added auto mine
[*] Added auto buy 
[*] Added auto kill
[*] Added Buy and Sell shortcuts to trading screen
[*] Added Buy all option to trading screen
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added default shortcuts to almost every screen (sometimes pressing keys would crash the game, Not anymore)
[*] Fixed rebirth AGAIN
[*] Added a potential fix for the background loop crashing
[/list]
